svg.title: Measured Tesla T4 synthetic inference speedup
svg.desc: Identical trained model weights on CPU versus CUDA in a single Colab Tesla T4 session. For 3,200 simulated individuals by five timing options, median times were CPU 26.820 milliseconds and CUDA 1.259 milliseconds, ratio 21.30. For 160,000 simulated individuals by five timing options, CPU 237.679 milliseconds and CUDA 20.659 milliseconds, ratio 11.50. Each workload had three timing repetitions; not a real-patient or complete causal pipeline benchmark.
svg.text: Tesla T4 | Measured synthetic inference speedup
Identical weights and inputs · 3 repeats · single Google Colab session · 21 October 2026
Bars show CPU/CUDA inference-time ratios, not execution times. Max output difference: 1.19 × 10^-7.
Synthetic workload only · Model transfer and warmup excluded · Not clinical efficacy or full-pipeline acceleration
